title: Group Room Blocks Schedule: Block Size and Booking Window by Block Type
content:
Group Room Blocks are contracted under six block types, each matched to one kind of organiser and each bounded by four limits: the fewest and the most rooms on the busiest night of the request (the peak night), the fewest total room nights, and the most calendar days between contracting and arrival. Every block type is entered under a signed contract.

| Block type | Organiser | Fewest rooms on the peak night | Most rooms on the peak night | Fewest total room nights | Most calendar days from contracting to arrival |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | a private individual or club | 10 | 50 | 20 | 540 |
| Wedding Room Block | a couple or family | 10 | 75 | 20 | 730 |
| Sports Team Room Block | a team or league | 10 | 60 | 20 | 365 |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | a licensed tour operator | 10 | 40 | 10 | 730 |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | a company | 10 | 150 | 20 | 730 |
| Association Convention Room Block | an association or society | 50 | 600 | 100 | 1825 |

### Reading the schedule

- Rooms on the peak night are counted in whole rooms; total room nights in whole room nights; the booking window in calendar days.
- The two peak-night columns are inclusive bounds: a request at exactly the fewest or exactly the most rooms shown sits inside the limit.
- The "most rooms on the peak night" figure is the largest block the hotel contracts under that block type.

### Worked reading (hypothetical request)

A licensed tour operator asks for 12 rooms on the peak night, 24 room nights in total, arriving 400 calendar days after contracting.

| Limit | Tour & Travel Series Block | Sports Team Room Block (same figures, for comparison) |
|---|---|---|
| Peak night between the two bounds | 12 lies between 10 and 40: within | 12 lies between 10 and 60: within |
| Total room nights at least the minimum | 24 is at least 10: within | 24 is at least 20: within |
| Arrival no more than the window | 400 is not more than 730: within | 400 is more than 365: outside |

The request fits every Tour & Travel Series Block limit; the same figures would exceed the Sports Team Room Block booking window.
